worktrees.about: Sidebar of repos, their worktrees (open or not) and terminals; Add project (folder, folder of repos, clone, new), New worktree, PR state and checks, Clean up, row menu, sessions, sleep

agents.about: Agents list that also shows agents running outside Herdr (Orca, iTerm…), an Active section, and what each working, waiting or finished agent is doing or said

palette.about: ⌘P / ⌘J that also finds worktrees (with the worktrees bundle) and makes new ones

restore.about: Resumes the agent sessions that ran when Herdr's core went (reboot, logout, crash)

usage.about: Claude Code and Codex plan limits at the left end of the bottom bar
usage.note: Claude and Codex limits are read from their installed CLIs, including Fable weekly limits on supported Claude Code versions. Optional snapshot fallback: hm-statusline before the Claude statusLine command, or ClaudeHUD display.externalUsageWritePath = ~/.herdr/usage/claude.json.

notify.about: macOS notification banners when an agent finishes or needs you while Herdr isn't in front
notify.note: Banners with Herdr's icon: build the helper app once with sh mods/mac-notify/notifier/build.sh (needs Xcode Command Line Tools); without it they come from Script Editor.

docs.about: Markdown files shown rendered in a pane beside the terminals (⌘P's Docs view, or an agent's hm md); it follows the file as it changes

commands.about: Lets agents (Claude Code, Codex) do what the sidebar and menus do, from words: the hm command and its skill
commands.note: hm works with the bundles it drives: worktrees for most commands, agents for hm outside, usage for hm usage, restore for hm restore, docs (and worktrees) for hm md. hm --help lists them.
